base: round-7 head lineage, backbone frozen, T=0.46 baked kept

gate._comment: Two different gates exist by design; the dashboard HTML is authoritative at runtime.

training_strict_gate.where: offline selection metric only (bench strict pass, OOD rejection training eval); stricter than tier-1 on purpose

known_limitations: 6-class closed-world head: other tomato diseases (septoria leaf spot, bacterial spot, target spot, leaf mold) share foliar features with the target classes and can pass tier-1; agronomic safety for off-target crops relies on the physical shroud and OE withholding.
Synthetic flat-green cards with drawn necrotic rings can fool both the foliar prefilter and the model (accepted as Tomato Healthy in adversarial tests).
Severe optical blur (6px) degrades diagnosis to ~53% but degrades SAFELY: blurred frames that lose confidence exit tier-1, chemicals withheld.
